reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.contents: I have used the relax melodies to help me sleep for some years and share it with all my friends. The meditations in particular really help me quiet my mind let go of worries and stresses and really relax into good sleep and positive frame of mind. This year in particular I suffered a traumatic experience in hospital on top of other stresses, the life saving treatment I was given repeatedly in hospital had adverse affect on my body (maybe allergy) it was actually overdosing my body, the psychological side effects of the drug were profound , it took some days for professionals to identify what was causing this, it was a lonely scary isolating time.  This app helped me stay calm in my hospital bed. When I returned home I was suffering adjustment disorder  and post traumatic stress. I used the SOS distress , dropping into the present moment and quieting your mind and back to sleep hypnosis routinely every time I woke up in extreme panic attacks and flashbacks- I cannot describe how these meditations helped me focus myself, orientate myself and get through the crippling fear and anxiety, they were my lifeline every night for about six weeks, until I was able to manage the panic  orientate myself and follow medical treatment plan.

reviews.title: No, No Way
reviews.contents:
It does not and will not work for me. First off, the meditation voice is a grating American one, I’m British, so it’s not calming, it’s infuriating and insincere. The sounds are appalling and unnatural. Suffered insomnia since I was 12, have lived in the middle of nowhere, quiet villages and cities around the world. My husband has a snoring issue, which we’ve done everything we can to solve, including surgery. I’m also prone to panic attacks, further hindering sleep. The “Natural” sounds in this app are some of the very worst I’ve heard, tried it on the Apple TV, iPhone and Bluetooth speaker, they sound dull and fake. I’m certainly not hauling a 30 pound amplifier and surround speakers into the bedroom in an attempt to make this sound more realistic. The looping of the sound is headache inducing, like a ticking clock or rhythmic snoring. The only thing I’ve ever found that relaxes me and puts me out is a genuine violent thunderstorm and torrential rain. This app is nowhere close to reproducing that sound in a natural random way, as I said, the repetitive looping drives me mad. I’ve downloaded a dozen or so of these apps over the years, Thunderspace being the best, but still not good enough.
The best apps and only apps I’ve ever found that will actually eventually put me to sleep are the ones that play audiobooks. Plus a monthly Audible subscription or a 30 hour long book on CD is so much cheaper than the subscriptions offered in this app.

reviews.title: FIXED: Can no longer mix audio with other apps
reviews.contents:
UPDATE: This is going to be fixed in an update and a workaround has been provided for me. Now rating it 5 stars, because it’s a truly brilliant app! 

The main reason I have been using Relax Melodies for years now is because I’d been able to have the app play a mix, and then go into Audible or Overcast and play a book or a podcast over the mix, which I’ve found to be a really effective way to get to sleep. As of a recent update, this no longer worked, and as soon as I play audio from another app the mix playing from Relax Melodies stops.

This change is a serious quality of life decrease for me because I have been incredibly reliant on this feature in order to sleep. PLEASE restore this feature or at least make it an option. I have no use for the app otherwise and will have serious issues sleeping until I find a replacement.

reviews.title: I don’t usually write reviews
reviews.contents: I don’t, but had to show my appreciation. Like most of you here I also cannot sleep when I need to if my life depended on it.... when I first tried the app I woke up next morning not remembering what happened 😂... it was working so well for that first month I wanted to try more music and meditations so purchased the full access... got a new phone now and was able to download the purchases here too...but yeah I literally just choose a sound I want to hear at that moment (campfire and ancestral makes me feel like im in an old american indian village ready to sleep😂)... have that woman speak to me about whatever and I always put the 30min shutdown timer on.... happy to say I never am awake before it finishes... blows my mind still to this day, think I've been using it for 3 years+ now. Recommend it to almost everyone i know

reviews.title: Bought this and can now no longer access it, as they have changed their business model.
reviews.contents: I have bought the premium version of this app, and have recommended it to numerous patients over the years. Now, however, I can no longer use the premium features (when I try to log in, it simply says that my user email address is not recognised) as the developers have changed their business model to an ongoing subscription scheme. When I bought the app, what I paid for was marketed as “life time use”. This is a clear con, and I will report this my country’s trading standards. I note that the developers have responded to another reviewer who had the same problem, saying that the buyer should produce “proof of purchase” - given that this was bought through the app store, this should be easy enough, but this arrogant attitude alone highlights the unethical tactics the developers are using.

reviews.title: Great idea, poor media
reviews.contents: I downloaded this with some enthusiasm and enrolled to the trial subscription so that I could test all the features. The concept is great with lots of options for mixing sounds to produce an almost infinite variety of soundscapes. But having tried to get to sleep with one of my creations I ended up being more irritated rather than sleepy. Firstly the sounds are all rather high frequency heavy. I found it very difficult to find anything that could add bass depth to my mix. Secondly, the sound loops are all extremely short, most noticeable with the musical loops. After a few minutes I started finding myself irritated by the same phrases being repeated over and over again. Even the sounds seemed to be repeating at regular intervals. Some of the meditations (all female American voices that I’m afraid I don’t find soothing) have great backgrounds but the app can’t come close to producing anything similar. It needs more sounds, more depth, some randomisation, longer music clips and some soothing male voices to get my long term support.

reviews.title: Perfection in an app
reviews.contents: I suffer from sleep problems due to having chronic pain and also ptsd, I totally recommend this app to anyone suffer from any type of sleep disorder, a while a go I asked about if there was any special offers for people with medical conditions, as my consultant had told me to find something that would help me sleep. I was told unfortunately there wasn’t but was given a months trial, when the trial finished I tried without the app and got into my old issue of not being able to sleep, I was desperate to get the app again as I had just been diagnosed with tittinitus and have constant noise in my ears. I was lucky enough to see the 30% off offer and now have the app back again 😊 even though I am an adult I live the stories on the app and they add new ones quite often. 100% recommend the app

reviews.title: Positively impacted my mental health
reviews.contents: I have been using this app since 2019, when I had bad insomnia, and always found it helped me to unwind before falling asleep. I no longer suffer from insomnia and am able to fall asleep without listening to anything as I am able to use the breathing/visualisation strategies that I have learnt from this app (I have pretty much memorised some of the Yoga Nidra recordings), which has been amazing. I now use Bettersleep for it’s day time meditations, which I do in the morning and it helps me to concentrate more fully when I go about my day. The CBT programme for anxiety is also been incredible, as it explains the scientific basis of CBT in a clear and straightforward way. Thank you to the makers of this app for making everything so accessible; I would recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: What happened ?
reviews.contents: I truly couldn’t live, let alone function without this app, as it literally is my the reason why i sleep, but for god sake… please STOP resetting or fix the obvious bug that makes it happen every time i turn it off for a few minutes, please STOP removing my fave mixes after a certain amount of time, and leaving me with just the standard one, it’s getting really tedious putting it on before bed and having to wait for it to reset and then for it to have taken my SAVED! mixes so then i have to spend ages going through them to make another. It’s honestly frustrating, i started paying for this app because you started putting literally all the best sounds behind a paywall, i expected for all that to stop when i started doing so, the free version is pretty much pointless now tbh, used to be one of the best free apps around.

reviews.title: Yet another app that doesn’t state up front….
reviews.contents:
….that you have to pay for most of the features. Eg. White Noise is free! Any other kind of similar noise is locked behind a paywall. 

On first launching the app you are taken through several gentle question and answers screens. Then after a very short while you get to the paid section, where you have to spot the tiny X at the top of the screen to get past them. After clicking on a few of them you then start hitting the Skip button a couple of times. Then you get the the screen that hints that all the best features will have to be payed for. Like the static type noises I already mentioned. I wish they’d been honest on the very first screen with a nice warning that listed all the features available for fee and those that are not, unless you pay. Then I could have decided sooner to delete the app. 

This app advertised relaxation but actually - for me anyway - did the opposite!
